census_source: W0 census (shared @covers / fixture builders / stimulus sequences)

evidence.pairing_signal: family adjacency from the W0 census (the github port is the delivery-verification side-effect seam of the verifier); NOT a same-covers pairing: the two suites carry distinct @covers keys, and the static detector (scripts/run-tests/redundancy-candidates.rkt, re-run during review: 93 same-covers groups, 333 shared-fixture groups repo-wide) reports no same-covers group and no shared-fixture group joining them
evidence.stimulus: not shared: the unit suite drives the verifier gate through a fake delivery-verification child process (exit status + branch state); the port suite drives the github adapter seam through a fake github adapter (correlated commands, external dedup, dry-run default, token redaction)

groups.finding: complementary assertion families over adjacent seams (verifier gate vs github port adapter); different @covers, different stimulus, disjoint assertions, both suites green
groups.policy_decision: keep both (preference order step 3: detection power ambiguous — there is no identical stimulus to share or merge; folding port assertions into unit tests would couple the module boundary to wire-format assertions)
groups.consolidation: none applied; candidates recorded with evidence links before touching anything

notes: No duplication with identical stimulus AND overlapping assertions was found. The delivery-verifier suite exercises the sync gate (24 test cases); the github-port suite exercises the port adapter (19 test cases); family total 43. Consolidation would reduce detection power, so no test was shared, merged, or deleted.
